prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: Legend of Dragoon EnvHD independent field foreground texture. Image1 is the authoritative original cutout. Image2 is the original scene for contextual lighting and role only. Repaint image1 as clean high-definition hand-painted game artwork compatible with restrained Skurfa-style HD environments. Crystal Palace cut369 slot16 narrow diagonal pale bed section running from upper left to lower right. Preserve the cool grey/cream bedding with a subtle dense faint woven pattern of small muted pink, green and blue-grey flecks, the pale upper fold and soft cloth shading, and the small warm golden-brown curved footboard with its thin upright post at right. The textile must retain delicate small-scale color variation, not plain white foam, stone or a coarse pixel mosaic. Keep the original narrow silhouette, gold footboard size and stepped cutout footprint. No invented motifs, trim, additional objects or brighter scene lighting. Strict canvas: exactly 32:30 aspect ratio, same source silhouette, crop, perspective, visible footprint, internal planes and negative space. Do not center, rotate, widen, pad or recompose it. Refine continuous hand-painted material detail without copying the low-resolution pixel mosaic. Output only this isolated texture on real transparency, with no background, scene, border, labels, text, logo or comparison board. Exactly one finished texture.

Refinement 1:
Edit the high-definition draft in image2 using original source image1 and scene image3. Retain exact pale-grey/cream cloth geometry, narrow diagonal crop, soft folds and warm golden-brown footboard/right upright post. Remove recognizable floral leaves and pink flower silhouettes from the cloth. Replace them with a very subtle dense pattern of tiny irregular muted pink, green and blue-grey woven flecks/geometric thread marks, with no recognizable plants or new emblem shapes. Match the faint small pattern scale of original bedding. Keep gentle original brightness and exact source occupied footprint; do not add padding or background. Output real transparency. Exactly 32:30 canvas aspect.

review.intent: Crystal Palace cut369 slot16 narrow diagonal pale grey/cream patterned bedding and warm golden-brown curved footboard with thin right upright.
review.style: Original, held neural, rejected floral draft, corrected output and isolated source slot placement compared. Delicate dense tiny pink/green/blue-grey woven flecks restore original pale color variation; recognizable flowers/leaves from the draft were removed. Fine pattern topology, folds, post geometry and wood grain are interpretive.
review.layout: Exact4x canvas [32, 30] to [128, 120]; source alpha and visible-black classes exact. Pinned cutout stage extends 237 target pixels, uncovered 164, maximum squared extension distance 26. Individual comparisons support broad source proportions and placement; they do not prove interior topology, state visibility, occlusion or gameplay.
